source.title: Changes in the Board of Directors (September 2022)
source.content:
Due to the terms ending for both Callum Goodyear and Saransh Grover on the Board of Directors, an anonymous election took place on August 31, 2022 to elect new members. The election was done according to [Motion 5.2021.1: Election of Directors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2021.1%2520-%2520Election%2520of%2520Directors.pdf).
<!-- break -->
The Board received applications from:

Callum Goodyear
Calvin Nielson

We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that Callum was elected to renew his term on the WCA Board of Directors! We wish him the best of luck with his duties! We thank Calvin for his application and his continued commitment to the WCA. We would also like to thank Saransh for his work on the WCA Board during his term.

Applications from both candidates can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kOgXnr1hVjptxJf6giBoG24H5QPdogwE?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2022 年 9 月）
translation.content:
Callum Goodyear 和 Saransh Grover 的董事任期即将结束，WCA 于 2022 年 8 月 31 日举行了不记名选举，选出新一届成员。此次选举依据[动议 5.2021.1——董事选举](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2021.1%2520-%2520Election%2520of%2520Directors.pdf)进行。

董事会收到以下两人的申请：

* Callum Goodyear
* Calvin Nielson

我们很高兴地宣布，选举顺利完成，Callum 成功连任 WCA 董事！祝他履职顺利。感谢 Calvin 提交申请，以及他对 WCA 的持续投入。也感谢 Saransh 在董事任期内所做的工作。

两位申请者的材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kOgXnr1hVjptxJf6giBoG24H5QPdogwE?usp=sharing)查看。
